name: Reject invalid CSV file constraints -- @1.8
fullName: Manage the product CSV lifecycle: Reject invalid CSV file constraints

steps.name: Given the RDB user is authenticated as "producer"
Given the producer is enabled for the RDB initiative
And the RDB product CSV has defect "unsupported category"
When the producer validates the RDB product CSV
Then the RDB operation fails with error "product.invalid.file.category"
